'''Lotus Closes Its Blossom''' is a [[sword form]]. The form is conventionally used against a single opponent. It is often followed by the swordsman wiping or shaking the blood off of the blade before sheathing the sword as a finishing flourish.{{ref/book|12|41}} This is reflected by the word "closes" in the name of the form.

==In practice==
[[Gawyn Trakand]] cut through two [[Seanchan]] with this form before sheathing his blade. [[Gareth Bryne]] almost did not recognize the unconventional application of the form as he had "never seen it used so effectively against two men at once."{{ref/book|12|41}}
